title: Orion Browser by Kagi
summary: Orion Browser is a privacy-focused web browser developed by Kagi, known for their premium ad-free search engine. The browser emphasizes user privacy, fast performance, and clean browsing experience without tracking or data collection.
problem_solved: Provides a privacy-respecting alternative browser that doesn't harvest user data or show intrusive advertisements
why_valuable: Kagi's commitment to user privacy and their track record with their search engine brings credibility to a browser that truly respects user data
